title: Actor–critic laboratory
description: Trace how an actor changes action probabilities while a critic supplies value, TD-error, advantage, and off-policy corrections.
ready: Ready. Sample one episode or run a finite budget.
failed: The experiment could not start. The chapter explanation remains available.
policyBody: Rows show softmax action probabilities for the two non-terminal states. Off-policy mode samples from μ and corrects with ρ = π/μ.
environmentBody: From s0, action 0 moves to s1 with reward 0; action 1 ends with reward 1. At s1, action 0 ends with reward 2 and action 1 with reward −1.
finiteRun: A finite trace makes the information flow visible; it is not an asymptotic convergence proof.
question: Compare A2C and off-policy mode. Which quantity changes the actor update: the TD error alone, or the TD error multiplied by an importance ratio?
